title: Rabbi Naftali Besser: Staying Inspired- “Parashat Ahare Mot"

chapters.title: The meaning of Aharei Mot
chapters.about: Nadav and Abihu, death, connection to Parashat Shemini

chapters.title: Topics of the Parasha
chapters.about: Yom Kippur, Cohen Gadol, inappropriate relationships

summary: Rabbi Besser discusses the themes of Parashat Aharei Mot, focusing on the connection between the death of Nadav and Abihu and the service of the Cohen Gadol on Yom Kippur. He explores the concept of atonement and the importance of modesty, or tsniut, in one's service to Hashem.
questions: Why does the Parasha begin by mentioning the death of Nadav and Abihu?
How does the death of righteous people provide atonement?
What is the true meaning of tsniut in our daily lives?
Why was the Cohen Gadol's service on Yom Kippur performed in private?
